title: Data dashboard for highways maintenance
body: The council seeks a supplier to build a maintenance dashboard. Estimated contract value £180,000 over two years. Bidders must hold Cyber Essentials. Tenders must be submitted by 15 December 2026.

title: Analytics support, single lot
body: Estimated value £95,000. Deadline for tenders: 12 November 2026. ISO 9001 required.

title: Secure records platform
body: All supplier staff must obtain SC clearance before starting. Value £400,000. Closing date 20 January 2027.

title: Small survey analysis
body: Analysis of a resident survey. Budget up to £18,000. Responses due 30 December 2026.

title: National data platform framework
body: Framework in 3 lots with a total estimated value of £12,000,000. Suppliers must hold ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials Plus. Submit tenders by 2 February 2027.

title: Contract award notice: transport model
body: Contract award notice. The contract for the transport model was awarded to Example Ltd for £210,000.

title: Information security reporting
body: Bidders must be certified to ISO 27001. Estimated value £260,000. Deadline 8 January 2027.

title: Energy data audit
body: We have spent £2,500,000 on energy over the last decade. This audit has an estimated value of £75,000 and tenders close on 18 December 2026.
